name: Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026
short_description: The Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 is a full marathon and multi-distance race held on 9 August 2026 in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 takes place on 9 August 2026 at Menara Sarawak Energy in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. Organized by Sarawak Energy Berhad, the event offers four distance categories: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km, with entry fees ranging from RM40 to RM140 depending on the chosen distance and how early a runner registers. Registration for the 2026 edition closed on 30 June 2026.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, half marathon, full marathon) suit different fitness levels
Affordable entry fees ranging from RM40 to RM140, with 100% of registration revenue going to Sarawak charities
AIMS-certified routes across all four distances
Centrally located venue at Menara Sarawak Energy in Kuching
cons: Registration for the 2026 edition closed on 30 June 2026
The full marathon flags off at 1am, so most of the scenic route is run in darkness
research_highlights: The 2026 edition is an 11-race-history event (rebranded from the Sarawak Energy Isthmus Run, first held in 2013), with four categories: 42km full marathon, 21km half marathon, 10km competitive run and 5km fun run.
Full marathon flag-off is scheduled for 1am from Sarawak Energy Menara, likely to avoid Kuching's daytime heat and humidity.

The route passes major Kuching landmarks including the Darul Hana Bridge, Sarawak Legislative Assembly Building, Borneo Cultures Museum, the Kuching cat statue, Kuching Waterfront, Juma'ani Bridge and Satria Pertiwi Complex.
All routes are AIMS-certified (Association of International Marathons and Distance Races), a new international accreditation added for the 2025/2026 editions.
Registration fees are reported as among the lowest for a full marathon in the region (RM90 full marathon, RM70 half marathon, RM60 10km, RM40 5km), with 100% of proceeds going to charity.
research_watchouts: Registration closed on 30 June 2026, per both the organiser's own coverage and Sarawak state news -- several aggregator listings still described entry as open well after that date.
AIMS lists no course profile and refers runners to the race website for the route map, so elevation detail is not available from an independent source.

faqs.question: When is the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on 9 August 2026. The event is held at Menara Sarawak Energy in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. Registration for this edition closed on 30 June 2026, so runners hoping to take part should watch for the 2027 event.

faqs.question: What distance options are available?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from four distance categories at the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026: a 5km run, a 10km run, a 21.1km half marathon, and the full 42.195km marathon, allowing participants of varying experience and fitness levels to take part.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: Registration fees for the Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 range from RM40 to RM140, depending on which distance category a runner selects. This pricing structure covers the 5km, 10km, half marathon, and full marathon options offered at the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the event and where is it located?
faqs.answer: The Sarawak Energy Marathon 2026 is organized by Sarawak Energy Berhad. The race is based at Menara Sarawak Energy in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia, serving as both the venue and the host city for this multi-distance running event.
